d:
Join archaeologists as they dig beneath twenty feet of volcanic ash to uncover the secrets of Pompeii’s Stabian Baths. From ancient hairpins and clothing fasteners to brilliant Roman engineering, we explore what everyday life and survival really looked like before Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 AD.
An all-female cast of archeologists make the discovery of a century, find an amphitheater and search beneath the waves for an ancient resort.
